title: United States perils
text:
United States perils

Perils and peril codes that 
Touchstone

 supports for the United States.
Wildfire sub-peril is available for U.S. exposures only, by separate license.

Note:
 With 
Touchstone
 2021, you can
 import hail, tornado, and straight-line wind as separate perils, for the 
Verisk Severe Thunderstorm Model for the United States
 only. You can use the exposures for both the current
 and previous (archive) versions of the model. The new codes are PHL (hail), PTD
 (tornado), and PSW (straight-line wind).

| Import peril code | Peril | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| PAL | All licensed perils | |
| PEA | All earthquake perils including wildfire/bushfire | |
| PEF | Fire (wildfire/bushfire, fire following earthquake) | |
| PFF | Fire following only | |
| PES | Earthquake shake only | |
| PFL | Inland flood | Applies to on-plain and off-plain flooding associated with non-tropical
 systems in the contiguous U.S. |
| PHL | Added in version 9.0: Severe thunderstorm with hail ( Verisk Severe Thunderstorm Model for the United States only) | |
| PLS | Landslide | |
| PNC | Non-catastrophe | Important: Non-catastrophe loss analyses were retired in Touchstone 2021 (9.0).
 Therefore, these fields do not affect losses. |
| PPH | Precipitation flood for the Verisk Hurricane Model for the United States | |
| PSH | Hurricane storm surge | |
| PSL | Earthquake sprinkler leakage only | |
| PSW | Added in version 9.0: Severe thunderstorm with straight- line wind ( Verisk Severe Thunderstorm Model for the United States only) | |
| PTD | Added in version 9.0: Severe thunderstorm with tornado ( Verisk Severe Thunderstorm Model for the United States only) | |
| PTR | Terrorism | |
| PTS | Tsunami | |
| PWA | All wind perils (tropical cyclone, severe storm, and winter
 storm) | Winter storm sub-peril is valid for U.S. exposures only. |
| PWB | Wildfire/bushfire only | |
| PWF | All wind and fire following earthquake perils, and
 wildfire/bushfire | |
| PWH | Tropical cyclone only | Plate glass sub-peril is available with Verisk Hurricane Model for the United States , by separate license. |
| PWT | Severe thunderstorm | |
| PWW | Winter storm | |
| PWX | Severe storm (wind excluding tropical cyclone) | Winter storm sub-peril is valid for U.S. exposures only. |
